svg.text: Page 2 of 3: Skills · Agents · Framework Files · Templates · Hooks · v0.13.0
Skills — 17 Slash Commands (each is a SKILL.md loaded into Claude's context)
Bootstrap migration: creates .claude/modernize/, copies migration.md template,
detects git remote, patches .gitignore. Precondition: no state.json exists.
Detects source stack + interview. Method A fans out legacy-analyzer loop-until-dry
(workflow) for exhaustive discovery; single-pass fallback. Writes analysis.json.
Reads migration.md (validates REQUIRED sections) + analysis.json; generates ordered
units/*.json + plan.md (incl. dependency graph). Precondition: analyzed.
Toolchain preflight, then creates target UI/API/DB skeleton from framework recipes;
copies legacy assets. Writes verify.config.json. Precondition: planned.
Migrates authentication end-to-end (login · logout · session · password hashing).
Reads API target's auth notes. Creates __auth__ unit. Precondition: scaffolded.
Auto-selects next eligible unit (respects depends_on graph); delegates to
unit-migrator agent inline. Precondition: auth_done or in_progress.
Explicitly migrate a named unit (bypasses auto-selection). Supports --force to
override unmet depends_on. Same migration loop as /next.
lint · typecheck · tests + behavioural-parity + security gate; advisory quality
review. Transitions migrated → verified. Precondition: ≥1 migrated unit.
Read-only dashboard: phase, per-unit progress, heartbeats, blockers, artifact-drift
staleness, suggested next action. Never mutates state. Any status.
Generates stakeholder report with burndown, velocity, risk assessment, effort
Reconciles state.json + per-unit files after git pull from a team member.
Merges unit_ids[], stacks, scaffold cleanly. Requires no uncommitted changes.
Re-attempts a failed unit. Supports --with-prompt to inject additional guidance
into the migration context. Resets in_flight, reruns translation loop.
Reverts one unit's target files; resets unit status to pending. Non-destructive to
other units. Precondition: unit is migrated, verified, or failed.
Destructive: --soft clears state.json, --hard also deletes scaffold dirs,
--unit marks one unit as skipped. Requires confirmation. No in-flight units.
Force-clears the advisory lock on state.json (10-min TTL). Only /plan and
/scaffold are guarded by this lock. Requires typing "force-clear".
Behavioural + security diff of migrated vs legacy (validation, output shape, errors,
UI, authz/injection/secrets). Acknowledge intentional diffs. Gates /verify.
Advisory idiomatic-code review — flags "JOBOL" / legacy-paradigm leakage in the
migrated code. Never blocks. Same critic /verify runs as advisory step 5b.
Only high parity/security diffs block; quality never blocks.
All skills read state.json on entry to check precondition and redirect if status is wrong. Skills cannot invoke other skills — they instruct Claude to suggest the next command.
Framework Files — 31 .md files (data-driven: drop 1 file = add 1 stack, no plugin code changes)
jquery · php-classic · coldfusion · vbscript-asp · rails · django
Sections: Scaffold · Test framework · Dev server · Wire to API
Unknown stack → 3-question fallback (scaffold cmd / test / verify)
Sections: Scaffold · Auth notes · Test framework · Dev server
Auth notes read by /auth; unknown → OWASP + permanent-gotchas
Templates + Workflows (copied / shipped with the plugin)
finds in-flight units owned by this dev/host → bumps last_heartbeat
